description: This file defines the WorkEffortSearchSession class, which manages search options, constraints, and sorting for work effort searches within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to handle search parameters, maintain search state in session, and generate constraint representations.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchSession
classes.description: Utility class managing search options, constraints, and sorting for work effort searches, including session state handling and parameter processing.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchOptions
classes.description: Stores search constraints, sort order, view index/size, and provides methods to manipulate these options within session.

methods.name: getWorkEffortSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the current WorkEffortSearchOptions object from session.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes search parameters from an HTTP request, updating session search options and constraints accordingly.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a new search constraint to session options.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sorting order for search results in session options.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the list of previous search options for session.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns human-readable strings of current search constraints.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the current sort order.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Adds current search options to history if they have changed.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a constraint from search options by index.

methods.name: searchClear
methods.description: Clears current search constraints and options.
